summary: Woodbridge Liquidation Trust filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 7 to its Liquidation Trust Agreement, extending the outside termination date from February 15, 2027 to February 15, 2030, subject to Bankruptcy Court approval. The amendment, executed by Liquidation Trustee Michael I. Goldberg on July 28, 2026, follows a pending construction defect claim against a subsidiary. The Trust will file a motion seeking court approval to extend the termination date to February 15, 2028 initially. This is a routine administrative step in an ongoing liquidation, not a new special situation.
